why: The base text loses its multiplier: `.hud` sizes at the page's 1rem whatever the player's UI scale, so every `em` under it -- pane titles at the UA's 2em, the disabled-reason `.ui-hint` at 0.85em, the Records tables -- stays put while the controls around it grow. Measured before issue #1031 with exactly this rule: at 150%, 3 of 40 text elements on Records and 16 of 19 on Settings scaled. jsdom resolves no `var()`, so only the stylesheet guard sees it.
